Title: The Lighthouse Keeper's Cat

FADE IN:

EXT. LIGHTHOUSE - DUSK
Waves crash against black rocks. A drone shot rises over the lighthouse as the lamp flickers on.

INT. LIGHTHOUSE KITCHEN - NIGHT
MARGOT (70s), wiry, in a fisherman's sweater, sets down two bowls. Her cat, BISCUIT, ignores both.

MARGOT
(dry)
You'll eat when the storm comes. You always do.

Close on Biscuit's tail flicking.

INT. LAMP ROOM - LATER
Margot climbs the last steps, out of breath. The camera circles around her as she wipes the big lens.
MARGOT (V.O.): Forty years, one lamp, one very rude cat.

EXT. ROCKS - DAWN
Wide shot. The storm has passed. Biscuit sits on a rock, a fish in his mouth, proud.

CUT TO:

INT. LIGHTHOUSE KITCHEN - MORNING
Margot laughs. She pulls back the curtain and the sun floods in.
